resume: Free offers at 15 and 16, €50 at 17, €150 at 18: the documents to prepare for registering in the app and the time limits for using it.
aQuoiCaSert: The pass Culture (France's culture pass for young people) makes culture easier for young people to access: books, cinema tickets, concerts, shows, lessons, musical instruments. It has an individual part, used by the young person in the app, and a collective part, used by teachers for class outings, from 6e (sixth grade) to terminale (final year of high school). Bookings are made in the app, with partner venues.
quiEstConcerne: Young people aged 15 to 18 living in mainland France or in an overseas territory, including Réunion.
Young foreign nationals who have lived in France for at least 1 year.
aSavoir: Young people covered by the rules in force since March 1, 2025: free offers at 15 and 16, €50 at 17, €150 at 18.
The credit can be used until the day before the young person turns 21.
Since early 2026, purchases of online offers (music, video, video games, audiobooks, digital press) are capped at €50. This cap does not apply to young people with a recognized disability.
A €50 bonus after 18 is planned for young people with a disability or who meet social criteria.
Registration: the young person's ID and proof of address. If they live with someone else, you also need a letter confirming they house the young person (attestation d'hébergement) and the host's ID.
